prompts.knight: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation SPRITESHEET on actual transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no labels, no floor, no shadows outside character. Reference 1 is approved game style and knight design: match medium-detail pixel clusters, NOT highly detailed painting nor crude 16-color toy. Exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 24 isolated full-body sprites, spacious equal cells, identical scale and baseline across ALL cells. All facing RIGHT, strict side view. SAME adult human knight every cell: silver closed medieval helmet with short cyan visor, steel plate torso and articulated forearm, DARK trousers, burgundy red shoulder cape trailing LEFT, visible large cyan circular dragon-crystal at near hip powering silver mechanical near leg with dark knee joint, steel longsword. Roughly 50-pixel tall sprite aesthetics at native scale with clean 2-3 tone metal clusters, no ornamental engraving, no gradients. Row1 SIX subtle idle breathing/cape flutter poses, sword forward-down. Row2 SIX sequential run poses with clear alternating leg extension, contact/recoil/pass/contact/recoil/pass. Row3 SIX horizontal ground dash poses: lowered center, compressed knees, shoulder leaning forward, cape streams left, sword pointing diagonally forward, small cyan mechanical exhaust behind calf. Row4 SIX jump poses: tuck/takeoff, ascending, apex, falling extended feet, landing bent knees, return to ready. Each cell centered at same hip X with character entirely inside cell, no duplicated rows, no scene elements. Pixel edges sharp, simple broad metal highlights. Sheet aspect 3:2.
prompts.citizens: Use case: style-transfer. Production pixel-art game spritesheet with real transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard no labels no scenery. Preserve this five-column four-row layout and all right-facing poses, keep all characters equal height and planted baseline per row. Redesign these inhabitants as humans surviving a medieval magic world using dragon-crystal-powered mechanical prosthetics. Col1 wanderer: brown hooded rag cloak, visible battered metal shin and dim cyan wrist bead; no tool. Col2 civilian: ochre tunic, dark trousers, silver forearm with small cyan wrist core, cloth satchel, no weapon. Col3 farmer: muted sage hood/tunic, brim hat, visible metal shin, hoe clearly held across shoulder; Col4 hunter: dark teal hood, leather clothes, cyan prosthetic forearm, clearly curved bow; Col5 guard: blue-gray helmet and mail, simple shield and short sword, cyan hip core and silver shin. Human proportions not chibi, avoid tiny jewelry, smooth gradients, intricate illustration or oversized machinery. Each sprite isolated with plenty transparent margins for cropping; consistent body scale. Aspect5:4.
